profile.description: The profile object to use, including name, prompts, and examples

minecraft_version.description: The version of Minecraft to use. Set to 'auto' to automatically detect the version.

host.description: The minecraft server host address to connect to

port.description: The minecraft server port to connect to. -1 for auto-detect.

world_id.description: Optional canonical id for the Minecraft world. Used to scope durable saved places, storage, routes, and JourneyMap memory.

server_path.description: Optional local Minecraft server directory. If set, Mindcraft reads server.properties to derive a world identity.

world_path.description: Optional direct local world save path used to derive a world identity.

load_world_memory.description: Whether to load durable world-scoped structured memory.

warn_on_low_confidence_world_id.description: Warn in chat when durable world memory is skipped because only a low-confidence fallback identity is available.

auto_sync_journeymap_on_start.description: Opt in to importing JourneyMap bridge waypoints after world memory loads on startup.

journeymap_waypoints_path.description: Optional JourneyMap WaypointData.dat file or directory containing local waypoint data. Used as a fallback when the HTTP bridge is unavailable.

journeymap_auto_discover_waypoints.description: When no JourneyMap waypoint path is configured, search common local Minecraft and CurseForge instance folders for WaypointData.dat files.

base_profile.description: Allowed values: survival, assistant, creative, god_mode. Each has fine tuned settings for different game modes.

load_memory.description: Whether to load bot's previous memory

init_message.description: The initial message to send to the bot
init_message.default: Respond with hello world and your name

only_chat_with.description: List of agents to only chat with. If empty, the bot will chat publicly

speak.description: Whether to enable text-to-speech reading on the host machine

language.description: The language to automatically translate to and from using google translate

blocked_actions.description: List of actions that are blocked

relevant_docs_count.description: Number of relevant function documents to include in the prompt for LLM code writing

max_messages.description: Maximum number of recent messages to keep in context for LLM

num_examples.description: Number of examples to select to help prompt better LLM responses

max_commands.description: Maximum number of commands allowed in consecutive responses. -1 for no limit

narrate_behavior.description: Whether to openly chat automatic behavior like 'Picking up item!'

log_all_prompts.description: Legacy: write conversation_*.txt and memSaving_*.txt under bots/{bot}/logs. Superseded by transcript_logging; also gated by legacy_logs_enabled.

transcript_logging.description: Whether to append JSONL runtime transcript events under each bot directory

transcript_include_prompts.description: Whether transcript logs include full prompt bodies. Default true so the transcript is a self-contained record.

transcript_include_code.description: Whether transcript logs include generated action code

transcript_max_field_chars.description: Maximum characters for a single transcript field before truncation

debug_logging.description: When true, write high-frequency debug events (pathfinder ticks, mode evaluation, placeholder resolution detail) to bots/{bot}/debug/<sessionId>.jsonl alongside the transcript.

legacy_logs_enabled.description: When true, also write the legacy bots/{bot}/logs/conversation_*.txt and bots/{bot}/histories/*.json files. Off by default; the structured transcript is the canonical record.

transcript_retention_days.description: On agent start, prune transcripts/*.jsonl and debug/*.jsonl older than this many days. 0 disables pruning.

action_stuck_poll_ms.description: While action code executes, sampling interval for movement/inventory stagnation (used with action.stuck events).

action_stuck_after_ms.description: Emit action.stuck if no noteworthy movement/inventory delta for this long during a single executing action.

task_ledger_enabled.description: Persist current user task state and verified progress to bots/{agent}/task_ledger.json.

task_status_chat_enabled.description: Chat concise task milestone and blocker updates for long-running tasks.

task_status_heartbeat_ms.description: Minimum interval between repeated task progress chat messages.

task_history_limit.description: Number of completed or failed tasks to keep in the task ledger history.

mining_verify_completion.description: Require inventory or storage evidence before declaring mining objectives complete.

show_command_syntax.description: Whether to show "full" command syntax, "shortened" command syntax, or "none"

chat_ingame.description: Whether to show bot's chat messages in game chat

chat_bot_messages.description: Whether to publicly chat messages to and from other bots

render_bot_view.description: Whether to render bot view for user observation. Does not give bot vision.

allow_insecure_coding.description: Whether to allow newAction command that lets the LLM write/run code on the host computer. Loop syntax is rejected before staging, but this is still potentially insecure and should be sandboxed at the OS/container level.

code_timeout_mins.description: Number of minutes to allow code execution. -1 for no timeout

task.description: The task object to give the agent on start. If null, the agent will not have a task.

spawn_timeout.description: Number of seconds allowed for the bot to spawn before throwing an error. Increase when spawning takes a while.
